workload: Empty and parameterized tests; generated directory trees
repetition: Diagnostic invocation; no repeated study in inspected helper
limitations: Profile overhead is not an unprofiled speed estimate

workload: Deterministic applications and curated configuration matrices
metrics: Process wall time; coverage generation; failures
repetition: Default three timed repetitions and median; warm priming
controls: Named tool caches; pools; isolation; providers
limitations: Consecutive cell repetitions do not establish independent-session uncertainty

workload: Assertion fast/slow paths; generated discovery listings
metrics: Elapsed time; scaling; generated registration count
repetition: Discovery five repeats across 1–16000 tests; hyperfine for other cases
limitations: Stress counts and diagnostic components are not typical suite workloads

workload: Real/example projects plus fixed instrumenter inputs
metrics: Project elapsed time; mutant count; duration thresholds
repetition: Project launcher timing and single-call component thresholds
controls: Local package configuration; expected mutant count
limitations: Manual workflow definition does not prove a continuous statistical gate

repetition: One invocation per strategy/delay cell in inspected loop
controls: Explicit synthetic delays and preserved per-cell artifacts
limitations: Needs repeated randomized blocks; throughput excludes other phases

workload: Coverage/timing-guided selection of tests for mutants
metrics: Killed survived uncovered nonviable timeout and error outcomes
repetition: Not established by consulted concepts page
limitations: Concepts page is not a verified comparative benchmark harness

workload: Project x Python x coverage configuration matrix
metrics: Raw command durations; medians; dispersion; ratios
repetition: Shuffled repeated combinations; default run method count three
controls: Environment setup separated; per-project adapters; persistent results
limitations: Audit unavailable baselines adapters and cached-result provenance

metrics: Command elapsed; Criterion comparisons; native profiles
limitations: Different analyzers or rule sets may perform different work

workload: Self-check or chosen project; edited incremental inputs
repetition: Default fifteen measured repetitions plus warmup; shuffled revision order
controls: Compiled artifacts; cache state; fixed Python hash seed

repetition: One warmup; five hyperfine runs; no shell
limitations: Does not establish coverage of all rules/plugins

repetition: Configured benchmark runs; no universal repeat count asserted
controls: Variant options and expected finding snapshots
limitations: Some historical dashboard links are internal; snapshot semantics need review

workload: Repeated function calls grouped into timed rounds
limitations: Rounds are not independent application process launches

metrics: CPU or real time; repetitions; structured output
repetition: Explicit warmup and repetition; optional random interleaving
limitations: Separate from GoogleTest; within-process samples are not independent machines

metrics: Workload time corrected by matched empty-method overhead
repetition: Pilot calibration; overhead/workload warmups and measurements
controls: Separate generated job and diagnostic lifecycle
limitations: Its overhead correction model does not automatically transfer to Godot workflows
